title: Comparatives & Superlatives — Module Test
description: Test your knowledge of the whole module: Comparatives & Superlatives. You need at least 6 out of 8 correct to pass.
canDo: I can use comparatives & superlatives confidently at A2 level.

questions.question: Which sentence is grammatically correct?
questions.explanation: Correct pattern for Comparatives: Short adj: -er (old → older) or more + adj (more expensive). Than: She is taller than me.

questions.question: Choose the word that correctly completes the sentence: She ___ happy.
questions.explanation: The + -est (the oldest) or the most + adj (the most interesting).

questions.question: Complete: We ___ enough chairs.
questions.explanation: Too + adj = excess (too hot) | Adj + enough (big enough) | Enough + noun (enough time)

questions.question: True or false: "This option is better." is correct English.
questions.explanation: This sentence follows the target grammar.

questions.question: True or false: "This is the best pizza in town." is correct English.
